newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Vietnamese Prime Minister arrives in Bangladesh.
newsitem.headline: Vietnamese Prime Minister arrives in Bangladesh.

text.p: Vietnamese Prime Minister Vo Van Kiet arrived here on Sunday on a two-day visit for talks with his Bangladesh counterpart Sheikh Hasina and business leaders.
The Vietnamese leader was greeted by Hasina at the airport when he flew in from India.
Kiet will attend a banquet hosted by Hasina later on Sunday after meeting Bangladesh Industry Minister Tofael Ahmed and Agriculture Minister Begum Matia Chowdhury.

Bangladeshi officials said the Vietnamese leader would hold formal talks with Hasina on Monday and witness signing of agreements for establishment of Joint Commission for economic, cultural, scientific and technological cooperation.
Kiet's visit is the first by a Vietnamese head of government to Bangladesh. He will also address Bangladeshi businessmen and meet President Shahabuddin Ahmed.
